development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.You’ll play an important role in:- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work- supporting offshore electrical environment- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.To succeed in the role, you:- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations- demonstrate technical leadership competence- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday.
